note: lxpt wire v1 and NOTICE v1 (spec/wire-v1.md). Generated by python/gen_fixture.py from the Python reference; every value is a TEST value derived from fixed labels, never a fleet key or identity. Byte fields are lower-case hex. 'messages': structural encode/decode vectors (signatures and MACs there are filler bytes). 'decode_refused'/'encode_refused': the error each must give. 'frames': FRAMEs sealed under the spurt keys derived from k_epoch, channel_id, talker_hash, spurt and nonce. 'notices': NOTICEs sealed under the channel's notice key. 'signed': CLAIMs and RELEASEs signed with Ed25519 by the 'seed' given; 'member_ok' is whether the talker tag is the signer's member tag under k_epoch and channel_id.
